checks.basis: The three product files matched the frozen manifest after testing; typecheck, SSR smoke, production build, and the corrected bounded artifact check passed. Isolated Browser evidence proved TTool discovery, local PNG import, real canvas dimensions after resize/rotation, flip state, PNG/JPEG/WebP encoding initiation with deterministic filenames, invalid-file and oversize recovery, full reset semantics, responsive visual integrity at the test viewport, empty app console warnings/errors, and complete tab/server cleanup. Source review independently bound quality and JPEG background controls to React state and canvas/export parameters.

non_blocking_observations: Vite emitted its non-failing renderer chunk-size advisory during the successful production build.

The in-app Browser download-event adapter timed out once even though the application reported a successful JPEG export; deterministic PNG/JPEG/WebP success toasts and the absence of export errors supplied the application-level evidence.
A Browser-client telemetry request timed out during an additional control review; it was outside the TTool page and did not appear in the page error/warn log.
residual_manual_boundary: No physical current-desktop input, global hotkeys, or focus takeover was used or required.
Animated images are intentionally rasterized as a static frame; metadata preservation, crop, batch processing, and annotation remain documented out of scope.
Codec availability remains browser-runtime dependent; unsupported encoding is handled by an in-tool recoverable error.
